title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #13 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does it mean to say that God is the sole Creator? (1 mark)
   A. God is the only Creator
   B. God had many helpers in creation
   C. God made only the animals
   D. God was made by someone

2. Zawadi is a Kiswahili name. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. A gift
   B. A mountain
   C. A river
   D. A road

3. According to Philippians 4:8, what should Christians think about? (1 mark)
   A. Whatever is unkind
   B. Whatever is false
   C. Whatever hurts others
   D. Whatever is true, pure and lovely

4. Feelings such as happiness, sadness and anger are: (1 mark)
   A. Always sinful
   B. Only for adults
   C. Never allowed
   D. Normal, but our actions must be right

5. Who said, "As for me and my household, we will serve the Lord"? (1 mark)
   A. Stephen
   B. Abraham
   C. Joshua
   D. Peter

6. You find a Ksh 100 note in the classroom. What is the right choice? (1 mark)
   A. Hide it
   B. Give it to the teacher to find the owner
   C. Spend it at the school shop
   D. Keep it quietly

7. What does it mean to honour your parents? (1 mark)
   A. To hide from them
   B. To ignore them
   C. To respect them, obey them and thank them
   D. To argue with them

8. Which Old Testament chapter tells the sad story of Tamar? (1 mark)
   A. Psalm 23
   B. 2 Samuel 13
   C. Exodus 20
   D. Genesis 12

9. Whom should you tell if someone touches you in a wrong way? (1 mark)
   A. A trusted adult such as a parent or teacher
   B. Nobody
   C. A stranger
   D. The person who touched you

10. Which of these is the correct way to handle the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Drop it on the floor
   B. Draw on its pages
   C. Carry it carefully and keep it clean
   D. Sit on it

11. What is the New Testament mainly about? (1 mark)
   A. The kings of Israel
   B. The creation of the world only
   C. Jesus, His teaching and the early church
   D. The Law of Moses only

12. Why did people dislike tax collectors? (1 mark)
   A. They were teachers
   B. Many took more money than they should
   C. They were poor
   D. They were farmers

13. In which town did Zacchaeus live? (1 mark)
   A. Jericho
   B. Jerusalem
   C. Nazareth
   D. Bethlehem

14. What did God first tell Balaam about going with Balak's messengers? (1 mark)
   A. Go at once
   B. Curse Israel
   C. Take a gift
   D. Do not go with them

15. What gave Samson the strength to kill the lion? (1 mark)
   A. His long hair alone
   B. The Spirit of the Lord
   C. His parents
   D. Special food

16. What should a child do if they meet a dangerous animal? (1 mark)
   A. Throw stones
   B. Go closer
   C. Try to fight it
   D. Stay away and call adults

17. What did Joseph advise Pharaoh to store during the good years? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. All the harvest
   C. One fifth of the harvest
   D. Half the animals

18. What did the seven fat cows stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Seven kings
   B. Seven rivers
   C. Seven years of plenty
   D. Seven years of famine

19. What was Sarai's name changed to? (1 mark)
   A. Leah
   B. Rachel
   C. Sarah
   D. Rebekah

20. Which of these shows obedience like Abraham's? (1 mark)
   A. Arguing
   B. Ignoring instructions
   C. Waiting for others
   D. Following good instructions even when it is hard

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain what the word "sole" means when we say God is the sole Creator. (3 marks)

22. Explain why we should thank God for making us. (3 marks)

23. State two promises that God made to Abram in Genesis 12:1-3. (2 marks)

24. Give three reasons why we should read the Bible. (3 marks)

25. State two ways of coping with anger. (2 marks)

26. Describe four steps you can follow when you feel very angry with someone. (4 marks)

27. Explain how the story of Balaam teaches obedience to God and respect for those in authority. (5 marks)

28. Explain how Proverbs 1:7 helps us to understand why Joseph was so wise. (5 marks)

29. Give three ways of showing respect to family members. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — God is the only Creator
   Sole means only. God alone made everything.

2. A — A gift
   Zawadi means a gift in Kiswahili.

3. D — Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   Philippians 4:8 lists true, noble, right, pure and lovely things.

4. D — Normal, but our actions must be right
   Feelings themselves are not bad. What we do with them matters.

5. C — Joshua
   Joshua 24:15 records these words.

6. B — Give it to the teacher to find the owner
   Honesty means returning what is not ours.

7. C — To respect them, obey them and thank them
   Honouring includes respect, obedience and thankfulness.

8. B — 2 Samuel 13
   The story of Tamar is in 2 Samuel 13.

9. A — A trusted adult such as a parent or teacher
   A trusted adult can protect you.

10. C — Carry it carefully and keep it clean
   We respect the Bible because it is God's word.

11. C — Jesus, His teaching and the early church
   The New Testament tells about Jesus and the early church.

12. B — Many took more money than they should
   Many tax collectors cheated people.

13. A — Jericho
   Luke 19:1 says Jesus was passing through Jericho.

14. D — Do not go with them
   God told him not to go and not to curse the people.

15. B — The Spirit of the Lord
   The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him.

16. D — Stay away and call adults
   The story is not a call to fight animals.

17. C — One fifth of the harvest
   Genesis 41:34 says to take a fifth.

18. C — Seven years of plenty
   Joseph explained that they were seven good years.

19. C — Sarah
   Genesis 17:15 records this.

20. D — Following good instructions even when it is hard
   Abraham obeyed God without knowing the whole plan.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sole means only. God alone made everything. Nobody helped Him and nobody made Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning of sole, 1 for God alone creating, 1 for no helper.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: God created us in His image and planned each of us. He gave us life, family and talents. Thanking Him shows that we value His gifts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God creating us, 1 for the gifts of life or talents, 1 for the link to giving thanks.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: To make him a great nation, to bless him, to make his name great, and to bless all peoples through him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid promise.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: It teaches right from wrong, comforts us, helps us to know God, gives stories of people who followed God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathe deeply, count to ten, walk away, talk to a trusted adult, pray. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Stop and breathe, count to ten, walk away if needed, tell a trusted adult, pray, forgive and make peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: God told Balaam what to say and do, and Balaam had to obey even though a king offered rewards. We should obey God's word and instructions from parents and teachers when they are good and right. Disobeying can put us in danger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's instruction, 1 for the reward temptation, 1 for obedience to God, 1 for obeying parents and teachers, 1 for danger of disobedience.

28. (5 marks)
   Answer: The fear of the Lord means respect and love for God. Joseph respected God, trusted Him and obeyed Him. God gave him wisdom, so he could interpret the dream and give good advice. We too should respect God to receive wisdom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning of the verse, 1 for Joseph respecting God, 1 for God giving wisdom, 1 for the good advice, 1 for application to us.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Greet politely, obey, help with chores, speak kindly, share, pray for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 3.
